description: Core + adapter permissions for the main editor window: dialog (folder picker), fs (working-copy read/write/watch), process (relaunch after update), and the self-updater. SECURITY: fs is currently scoped to the user's home tree ($HOME/**) so any picked folder works; before shipping, prefer narrowing this to the opened directory at runtime (tauri-plugin-fs FsExt::fs_scope().allow_directory) and dropping the broad static scope below.
